text: Runtime: In step 1, we sort the edges. This takes time O(Elog E), assuming we use Mergesort. In step 2, we carry out both Find and Merge operations. Each Find operation is constant, and we perform O(FE) finds, one for each edge in the tree. We showed above that the Merge operation is carried out at most O(log V) times for any one vertex, so over V' vertices, the total of all the merges is O(V log V). The total runtime is then O(V logV + Elog E) = O(E log E). Note however that E < V?* and so O(Elog E) = O(Elog(V?)) = O(Elog V). The runtime is the same as that for Prim’s.
